consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1980-01-13 show at Oakland Coliseum was a high-energy performance with standout moments, particularly in the opening songs and during the jammed-out sections. The collaboration with guest musicians, especially Carlos Santana, added to the excitement of the night, making it a memorable event despite its abbreviated format.
